title: A century for NYC's Pawnames
gallery_text: A speculative forecast of how New Yorkers might name their dogs over the next 100 years. Using NYC dog licensing data and a Markov model to generate new names, it simulates how naming patterns could spread and evolve through cultural influence, local adoption, and citywide trends.

answers.process: The prompt writing is actually interesting. I wrote in natural language as detailed as possible first and I improved the consistency of paragraph with LLM. It was different than so far what i had done with vibe coding. Since I already had a sketch from the previous assignment, this didn't take very long time.
answers.result: The simulation works well as expected with the prompt, while the visual parts doesn't feel right. I therefore sent a lot of time playing around with the graphic design and interactive experience.
answers.unexpected: My initial vision for this project felt convincing in theory, but it became less grounded as I began building the simulation. Many names generated by the mathematical model didn't really resemble names and were difficult to pronounce. I later realized that the procedural generator I used as a reference trains separate models on carefully selected datasets for different types of names. This suggests that I can improve both the simulation method and the project prompt by defining a training data & rules, and intended limits of name generation more precisely.
